sourced_from: Dinner Plan — Aug 24 to Sep 6, 2026 (Google Doc 1_qH6mIL626HJOSsUpBL30b9t6C4WED73eZSkXZiEZMA)
_provenance.SOURCED: meal names, active/total minutes, servings, protein grams, cuts, seasonings, all household rules, the portion table, store sections, shop cadence
_provenance.INFERRED — ANDREW MUST CORRECT BEFORE TH: every ingredient qty_per_person for vegetables, starches and aromatics. The docs give protein weights per person and name the sides, but never quantify the sides. Marked "inferred": true on each. The protein rows are sourced and are NOT inferred.
_provenance.count_note: 8 meals, not the ~20 the FOR-177 spec estimated. 8 is one complete fortnight rotation, which is the cycle Andrew actually runs. The spec's ~20 was an estimate, not a requirement.

fuel_household._comment: Andrew's row. Every value here is SOURCED.
fuel_household._people_note: Andrew + Lisa. Grace is an infant, not on the dinner rotation.
fuel_household._nights_note: 4 cook-nights/week; the rest is leftovers or eating out.
fuel_household._cap_note: ~30 min ACTIVE time on a weeknight, max. Note total time runs to 35; the cap is on active minutes.
fuel_household._diversion_note: THE critical value. 'Half of all meat bought or on hand gets cooked off for Andrew's meal prep. Only half of any inventory counts toward dinners; any new purchase must be doubled.' Getting this wrong makes a plan run out in week 2 — it has already happened once. This is learning L2 and for Andrew it is exactly 50%.

dietary_rules._turkey_note: NEVER 99% lean — patties fall apart and taste like nothing.
dietary_rules._steak_note: Consequence of the turkey rule: turkey replaces one chicken dinner in week 1 and the steak dinner in week 2.
dietary_rules._fat_note: No cream/butter/oil-forward sauces. Seasoning and acid do the work.
dietary_rules._ribeye_note: Lisa will not eat cheap steak.
dietary_rules._frugal_note: Reuse ingredients across meals rather than buying one-offs. Variety comes from spice profile and format, NOT from more ingredients — learning L5.

stores._topup_note: Mid-cycle trip is expected, not a failure. Week-1 fresh fish at Costco, week-2 fish and produce elsewhere — avoids buying a 3 lb frozen bag to use 1 lb. This is learning L3.

inventory._rice_note: New 25 lb bag as of Aug 2026. Do not rebuy.

portion_table_raw_oz_per_person._comment: SOURCED. Learning L4 — thigh != breast != cod for the same gram number. Drives every quantity.

fuel_meals.name: Cast-iron ribeye, roasted broccoli, baked russet
fuel_meals.rotation_note: The only steak in the fortnight. Does not reheat — cooks to order, 2 servings.

fuel_meals.name: Sheet-pan chili-lime chicken thighs, broccoli, sweet potato
fuel_meals.rotation_note: One pan. Best night of the week for a bad day. Cooks 3 so a leftover night comes free.

fuel_meals.name: Lemon-garlic salmon, green beans, rice
fuel_meals.rotation_note: FISH — week 1. Bought fresh at Costco with the main shop.

fuel_meals.name: Greek turkey rice bowl
fuel_meals.rotation_note: TURKEY — week 1. 'Bright and lean, nothing like the rest of the week. This is the variety night.' Lisa's meal.

fuel_meals.name: Garlic-herb skillet chicken thighs, green beans, potatoes
fuel_meals.rotation_note: Week 2. Same thigh as the chili-lime night, different profile and format — L5 in practice.

fuel_meals.name: Turkey burger patties, roasted broccoli, baked potato
fuel_meals.rotation_note: TURKEY — week 2, replacing the steak night. Bun optional; the potato is already the carb. 93/7 ONLY.

fuel_meals.name: Blackened cod or halibut, roasted broccoli, rice
fuel_meals.rotation_note: FISH — week 2. BOUGHT ON THE SECOND TRIP, not the main shop. This is the meal that forces the mid-cycle top-up — learning L3. Cod is leaner than salmon, so weigh heavier.

fuel_meals.name: Soy-ginger chicken breast and pepper stir-fry over rice
fuel_meals.rotation_note: Week 2. BREAST not thigh — deliberately, to keep a full pound of margin in the thigh bag. Active time is 25, close to the 30-min cap.
